panels.title: Top errors in the latest version (last 7 days)
panels.description: Fingerprints change with every release, so this is per version. Open the fingerprint in Bugsink (project bulwark-telemetry) for the resolved stack.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name, coalesce(message, '') AS code, fingerprint,
       count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS instances,
       count(*) AS instance_days,
       max(days) AS most_days_in_a_week,
       (array_agg(frames->0->>'path'))[1] AS top_frame
     FROM error_counts
     WHERE version = (SELECT version FROM error_counts GROUP BY version ORDER BY string_to_array(substring(version FROM '^\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}'), '.')::int[] DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AND day >= current_date - interval '7 days'
     GROUP BY name, code, fingerprint
     ORDER BY instances DESC, instance_days DESC
     LIMIT 50

panels.title: New errors per version
panels.description: An error counts as new in the first version it was reported for, by name and fixed code (fingerprints change with every build).

targets.rawSql:
WITH firsts AS (
       SELECT name, coalesce(message, '') AS code, min(string_to_array(substring(version FROM '^\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}'), '.')::int[]) AS first_key
       FROM error_counts GROUP BY name, code
     )
     SELECT ec.version,
       count(DISTINCT (ec.name, coalesce(ec.message, ''))) FILTER (WHERE string_to_array(substring(ec.version FROM '^\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}'), '.')::int[] = f.first_key) AS new_errors,
       count(DISTINCT ec.fingerprint) AS fingerprints,
       count(DISTINCT ec.instance_id) AS instances
     FROM error_counts ec JOIN firsts f ON f.name = ec.name AND f.code = coalesce(ec.message, '')
     GROUP BY ec.version
     ORDER BY string_to_array(substring(ec.version FROM '^\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}\.\d{1,4}'), '.')::int[] DESC NULLS LAST, ec.version
     LIMIT 20

SELECT fingerprint, version, name, coalesce(message, '') AS code,
       count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS instances,
       count(DISTINCT day) AS days
     FROM error_counts
     WHERE day >= current_date - interval '30 days'
     GROUP BY fingerprint, version, name, code
     ORDER BY instances DESC, days DESC
     LIMIT 100
